sentences.en: If you could only speak English, you would be perfect.
sentences.zh: 如果你只会说英语，你就是完美的。

sentences.en: You don't fall in love with somebody because he's perfect.
sentences.zh: 你不会因为某人完美无缺而爱上他。

sentences.en: It is true of learning English that "practice makes perfect".
sentences.zh: 学习英语确实有句俗话：熟能生巧。

mnemonic: per（全部）+fect（做）→全部做完→完美的
